correctness.rationale: For every four-point time set, Walsh-zero evaluation maps on any 3D independent frequency difference span have rank at most two, while none of six pairwise differences is in the kernel, forcing the missing seventh direction to annihilate all time differences. Boundary d=2 and all seven obstruction subfamilies checked. The standalone actual C++17 source passed 5,013 direct integer-enumeration tests; finite tests are corroboration only.

value.rationale: It gives a complete, uniform algorithmic decision criterion and exact multiplicity for a mathematically natural simultaneous orthogonal Fourier-basis problem, reducing arbitrary four-point families to 2D frequency subspaces. The joint-annihilator exponent predicts precisely how many nonaffine spectra accompany the affine ones, and the minimal three-family obstruction separates pairwise from collective spectrality; these are not routine normalization or table facts.
